description: machine-readable design tokens and brand constraints for algorhythmia.

brand.name: algorhythmia
brand.case_rule_specification: every word must be either all lowercase or ALL UPPERCASE. never mix both in the same word.
brand.mood: sober corporative goth x 90s cyberpunk avionics x ergonomic minimalism
brand.aesthetic_formula: SOBER CORPORATE GOTH * ERGONOMIC MINIMALISM * 90s CYBERPUNK AVIONICS
influences: teenage engineering (mechanical honesty, compact form, 1:1 tactile directness)
ghost in the shell (forensic opto-electronics, section 9 clandestine tech, dense pcb schematics)
cowboy bebop (cockpit avionics, analog clunk, warm crt scanline noir)
evangelion (nerv tactical telemetry, monospace warnings, cadmium alert flags)
akira (capsule industrialism, heavy stenciling, cryogenic laboratory hardware)

chromatic_distribution.rule: telemetry accents must be used strictly for functional status, clock, and clip; never as decorative backgrounds.

obsidian_void.role: primary application background, deepest obsidian canvas

basalt_surface.role: secondary surface, card backgrounds, recessed bays, chassis body

carbon_raised.role: elevated components, hover states, rotary dial bodies, button caps

forensic_slate.role: muted metadata, inactive labels, pcb ground plane fill

titanium_mist.role: secondary typography, parameter units, inactive icons

bone_chalk.role: primary typography, silkscreen white, active indicators

nerv_orange.role: instability warning, uncommitted buffer, parameter threshold alert

phosphor_green.role: clock synchronization, dsp locked, nominal running state

bebop_amber.role: standby mode, usb charging in progress, soft saturation indicator

akira_red.role: hard clipping limit, battery critical, emergency mute, write protect

optic_cyan.role: usb data activity, midi serial clock, host communication

display.name: DIN PRO CONDENSED
display.role: tactical headings, product identifiers, classification headers

body.name: neue haas grotesk text
body.role: editorial text, manual paragraphs, website copy

mono.name: jetbrains mono
mono.fallback: 'jetbrains mono', 'ibm plex mono', 'sf mono', menlo, consolas, monospace
mono.role: telemetry readouts, firmware parameters, code, memory maps, serial numbers

geometry_and_elevation.elevation_method: planar contrast and 1px hairline dividers; no blur or drop shadows

motion.rule: animations must be snappy and clinical; never bouncy, cartoonish, or elastic.

chassis_finish.process: micro bead-blast #180, type III hardcoat anodizing

optics.style: sub-surface micro-hole pinhole light guides with matte diffusion

prohibited_elements: mixing uppercase and lowercase within the same word (binary case law violation)
capitalizing brand name with mixed case (must be strictly all lowercase 'algorhythmia')
marketing buzzwords: revolutionary, game-changing, insane drop, magic, swag, vibes
cheesy goth tropes: skulls, medieval blackletter fonts, spikes, grunge textures
rainbow rgb lighting or disco led color cycling
curved blobby organic casework or glossy plastics
